20 in [[Blood Magic]] in [[Hard mode]].
* {{skill icon|Mark of Subversion}}
* {{skill icon|Order of Pain}}

== Notes ==
* This boss uses two skills (Well of the Profane and Order of Pain) which are not available at the [[skill trainer]]s until much later; you may want to use a [[Signet of Capture]].
*Shares a single spawn point with [[Ramm the Benevolent]], [[Torr the Relentless]], [[Nyle the Compassionate]] and [[Pleoh the Ugly]].
